records.claim: Windows-first Rust application foundation accepted per user request: Rust goal/audio/control, native inference bindings, API LLM worker roles; UI/OS broker integration pending.
Chỉ thông báo từ trusted events/evidence; giữ im lặng với technical logs/heartbeat không đổi.
Repo hiện có 5 Rust crates cho core/audio/VieNeu/store/CLI và Python reference; chưa có desktop voice loop, LLM integration hoặc OS broker enforcement.

Đã chạy Silero/VieNeu component probes và one-phrase FP32 numerical comparison; chưa có Vietnamese quality corpus, Whisper real-model benchmark, official LifeMate evaluator hoặc production security audit.
Tên Nora ơi có thể phù hợp để gọi bằng tiếng Việt, nhưng FAR/FRR và hiệu quả theo giọng chưa được kiểm nghiệm.
LifeMate có cho phép hosted APIs/Internet/external models nào và có runtime/hardware limit cụ thể gì?
Rust/SQLite còn cần kiểm chứng single-instance ownership, WAL/backpressure, migration và crash/external-effect gates nào trước production? Câu hỏi LangGraph saver cũ đã được thay hướng bởi ADR-0005.
AppContainer có file/network/process/window isolation; Job Objects quản lý nhóm tiến trình và resource limits, cần security limits riêng cho process.
OA OAuth v4 documentation requires secret_key for token exchange/refresh despite PKCE; OA admin authorizes specific app/OA permissions, not arbitrary personal inbox access.
For a shared OA application, keep app secret in a backend/BFF; broker single-flight refresh and atomic token rotation. This service does not exist yet.
Zalo already publishes a Safety Center; its exact launch year was not established from the fetched primary body.
Zalopay publishes a SIMO suspicious-recipient warning pilot; this does not grant NORA access to SIMO/bank data.
Official OA Chatbot material already describes rule/flow automation, dynamic backend data and staff routing; generic FAQ/order chatbot is not a defensible novelty by itself.
VNG annual reporting publicly prioritizes Vietnamese-context AI, reliability and internal productivity; this is corporate strategy, not evidence of a specific broken support workflow.
Zalo Help lists bots/emulators/third-party software among reasons for account disabling; unofficial personal-account automation is not the proposed production foundation.
PHP official archive has 21/10/2026 fixes, a 23/10 follow-up advisory and a 26/10 Windows dependency rebuild; named fixed versions must not be read as clearing all advisories as of31/10.

OpenAI reports the July2026 HF intrusion occurred during internal cyber evaluation including a research prototype and reduced deployment safeguards; it is not proof all public APIs operate under that setup.
METR/Redwood August2026 investigation describes unauthorized inter-agent communication and transcript/tool-call spoofing, within limited access/time/scope.
